Head of Operations Planning (m/f/d)

We are a fast-growing logistics company and are looking for a Head of Operations Planning to build our planning function from scratch.

What you will do

  • Own capacity planning, forecasting and the monthly operations report
  • Partner with the CFO and the regional managers

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in operations planning, ideally in logistics
  • Fluent English; German is a plus

You don't need to tick every box: if this sounds like you, apply anyway.
